Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to retrieve authoritative sources that confirm the location of the Waterloo Vase and its context of usage as a garden ornament at the residence and administrative headquarters of the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom. The initial reliance on Wikipedia snippets led to incomplete validation, despite further explicit queries being constructed to find primary confirmation from more credible sources such as royal.uk. Continuing the same query patterns without successful authoritative results indicated a failure to efficiently converge the search in productive directions, thus allowing the error to persist.
